# knowledge

Typed knowledge records, the kb tool that indexes and gates them, and the generated rules and indexes.

- Spec: `docs/features/knowledge/spec.md`
- Contract: `docs/features/knowledge/contract.md`

## Files

```
(none)
```

## Decisions

- `kb:adr/knowledge-diagrams-are-mermaid-records` — Diagrams are mermaid, in a closed kind list; system-wide ones are diagram records under docs/diagrams, feature ones sit inline in the feature spec. (accepted, 2026-09-15; features: knowledge) → `docs/adr/knowledge-diagrams-are-mermaid-records.md`
- `kb:adr/knowledge-kb-tool-is-a-separate-module` — The kb tool is the public module github.com/Zalaras/kb, pinned by a go.mod tool directive and run as go tool kb; this repo keeps kb.yaml and the records. (accepted, 2026-10-08; features: knowledge) → `docs/adr/knowledge-kb-tool-is-a-separate-module.md`
- `kb:adr/knowledge-pack-sections-scoped-by-role` — A pack carries only the sections its role acts on (decisions, facts, design docs, conventions per role); the role list is checked against the agent files. (accepted, 2026-10-06; features: knowledge) → `docs/adr/knowledge-pack-sections-scoped-by-role.md`
- `kb:adr/knowledge-protocol-sections-addressed-by-anchor-ids` — Protocol sections are addressed by stable anchor ids in HTML comments, not section numbers; every citation is an anchor token the kb check validates. (accepted, 2026-09-11; features: knowledge) → `docs/adr/knowledge-protocol-sections-addressed-by-anchor-ids.md`
- `kb:adr/knowledge-refs-and-scope-are-kb-subcommands` — Dead cited references and the changed-files feature scope are kb subcommands over the index; the full refs pass is part of kb check; the scripts are gone. (accepted, 2026-10-07; features: knowledge) → `docs/adr/knowledge-refs-and-scope-are-kb-subcommands.md`
- `kb:adr/knowledge-repo-values-live-in-kb-yaml` — Every repo-specific value the kb tool reads (record dirs, closed lists, paths, budgets, pack scoping, refs, scope) is a strict kb.yaml; the model stays code. (accepted, 2026-10-07; features: knowledge) → `docs/adr/knowledge-repo-values-live-in-kb-yaml.md`
- `kb:adr/process-touched-features-widen-without-stopping` — A Touches header names features a plan edits without changing; they pack as spec and contract only, the scope gate widens it itself, promotion is on evidence. (accepted, 2026-10-06; features: knowledge) → `docs/adr/process-touched-features-widen-without-stopping.md`
- `kb:adr/stack-config-yaml-goccy-strict` — kb.yaml is parsed by github.com/goccy/go-yaml in strict mode; record frontmatter keeps the hand-rolled flat scanner; the frozen go.yaml.in fork was rejected. (accepted, 2026-10-07; features: knowledge) → `docs/adr/stack-config-yaml-goccy-strict.md`
